title: THE LAST FRAME
logline: A freelance filmmaker discovers her old digital camera can record footage from the future, revealing a terrifying premonition and a warning not to trust her producer, Daniel, as she races against an impending disaster.

characters.name: FUTURE MAYA
characters.description: An exhausted and terrified version of Maya from the future.

characters.name: DANIEL
characters.description: A producer, also aware of the future video.

vfx_requirements: Camera screen displaying timestamp and messages
Room darker, furniture overturned, window shattered (VFX/Set Dressing)
Figure appearing behind Maya in camera footage
Train derailing footage on camera screen

scenes.heading: INT. MAYA'S APARTMENT - NIGHT
scenes.summary: Maya, a freelance filmmaker, discovers her old digital camera mysteriously recorded footage from "TOMORROW" showing a future version of herself giving a dire warning.

scenes.heading: ON THE LAPTOP SCREEN - VIDEO
scenes.summary: The video shows a future Maya in a ransacked apartment, urgently warning present-day Maya not to go to the station tomorrow, not to take the 11:47 train, and not to trust Daniel.

scenes.heading: INT. MAYA'S APARTMENT - LATER
scenes.summary: Maya receives a message and call from Daniel, who reveals he also saw the future video and instructs her to destroy the camera, as the apartment lights flicker and the camera begins recording again.

scenes.heading: INT. TRAIN STATION - NIGHT
scenes.summary: At the train station, Maya sees a live recording of herself with a mysterious figure behind her. She boards the train with Daniel, sees a future of the train derailing on her camera, and barely escapes before the train departs, prompting a "TIMELINE UPDATED." message.
